files.shabads/15/7746.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":7746,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":54,"page_no":129,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":80529,"last_verse_id":80533,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":80529,"page_no":129,"line_no":80529,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਸ ॥","translit_en":"kalas ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਕਲਸ।"}}},{"verse_id":80530,"page_no":129,"line_no":80530,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਅਭੈ ਅਨਗਾਧਿ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥","translit_en":"aadh abhai anagaadh saroopa(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art Primal, fearless and Unfathomable Entity"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਆਦਿ-ਸਰੂਪ ਵਾਲੇ, ਭੈ-ਰਹਿਤ, ਅਥਾਹ-ਸਰੂਪ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ"}}},{"verse_id":80531,"page_no":130,"line_no":80531,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ॥","translit_en":"raag ra(n)g jeh rekh na roopa(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art without affection, colour, mark and form."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਅਤੇ ਰੇਖਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।"}}},{"verse_id":80532,"page_no":130,"line_no":80532,"gurmukhi":"ਰੰਕ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਵਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਪੰ ॥","translit_en":"ra(n)k bhayo raavat kahoo(n) bhoopa(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Somewhere Thou art pauper, somewhere chieftain and somwerher king."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਕਿਤੇ ਕੰਗਾਲ, ਕਿਤੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ, ਕਿਤੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋ,"}}},{"verse_id":80533,"page_no":130,"line_no":80533,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੂੰ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਰਤਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੂਪੰ ॥੭॥੨੭॥","translit_en":"kahoo(n) samu(n)dhr sarataa kahoo(n) koopa(n) ||7||27||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Somewhere Thou art ocean, somewhere stream and somewhere a well.7.27."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਤੇ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ, ਕਿਤੇ ਨਦੀ, ਕਿਤੇ ਖੂਹ ਦੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੋ ॥੭॥੨੭॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":7745,"next":7747}}
files.shabads/15/7747.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":7747,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":54,"page_no":130,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":80534,"last_verse_id":80538,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":80534,"page_no":130,"line_no":80534,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥","translit_en":"tirabha(n)gee chha(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"TRIBHANGI STANZA"},"pu":{"ss":"ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ:"}}},{"verse_id":80535,"page_no":130,"line_no":80535,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਤਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੂਪੰ ਸਮੁਦ ਸਰੂਪੰ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥","translit_en":"sarataa kahoo(n) koopa(n) samudh saroopa(n) alakh bibhoota(n) amit gata(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Somewhere Thou art in the form of stream, somewhere well and somewhere Ocean Thou art of Incomprehensible wealth and Unlimited movement."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਕਿਤੇ ਨਦੀ, ਕਿਤੇ ਖੂਹ, ਕਿਤੇ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਦੇ ਸਰੂਪ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ, ਨਾ ਲਖੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਵਿਭੂਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਅਸੀਮ ਗਤਿ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ,"}}},{"verse_id":80536,"page_no":130,"line_no":80536,"gurmukhi":"ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਤੇਜ ਸੁਰਾਸੀ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥","translit_en":"adhavai abinaasee param prakaasee tej suraasee akirat kirata(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art Non-dual, Indestructible, Illuminator of thy light, the outlay of splendour and Creator of the Uncreated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਦ੍ਵੈਤ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ, ਅਵਿਨਾਸ਼ੀ, ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਵਾਲੇ, ਤੇਜ ਦੀ ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਤੇ (ਕਿਸੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ) ਨਾ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਹੋ,"}}},{"verse_id":80537,"page_no":130,"line_no":80537,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਖੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ॥","translit_en":"jeh roop na rekha(n) alakh abhekha(n) amit adhavaikha(n) sarab miee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art without form and mark, Thou art Incomprehensible, Guiseless, Unlimited, Unblemished, manifesting all forms."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਰੂਪ ਅਤੇ ਰੇਖਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਅਲੱਖ, ਅਭੇਖ, ਅਮਿਤ, ਦ੍ਵੈਸ਼ਰਹਿਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਬ-ਮਈ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":80538,"page_no":130,"line_no":80538,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਅਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣੰ ਏਕ ਦਈ ॥੮॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"sabh kilavikh harana(n) patit udharana(n) asaran sarana(n) ek dhiee ||8||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art the remover of sins, the redeemer of sinners and the only Motivator of keeping the patronless under refuge.8.28."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਹ ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ, ਪਤਿਤਾ ਦਾ ਉੱਧਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ, ਨਿਆਸਰਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਇਕ ਮਾਤਰ ਦੇਵ ਹੋ ॥੮॥੨੮॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":7746,"next":7748}}
files.shabads/15/7748.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":7748,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":54,"page_no":130,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":80539,"last_verse_id":80543,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":80539,"page_no":130,"line_no":80539,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਸ ॥","translit_en":"kalas ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਕਲਸ।"}}},{"verse_id":80540,"page_no":130,"line_no":80540,"gurmukhi":"ਆਜਾਨੁ ਬਾਹੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕਰ ਧਰਣੰ ॥","translit_en":"aajaan baahu saara(n)g kar dharana(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou hast long arms uptil Thy Kness, thou holdest the bow in Thy hand."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਗੋਡਿਆਂ ਤਕ ਲੰਬੀਆਂ ਬਾਹਵਾ ਵਾਲੇ, ਹੱਥ ਵਿਚ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਧਨੁਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਧਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ,"}}},{"verse_id":80541,"page_no":130,"line_no":80541,"gurmukhi":"ਅਮਿਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਰਣੰ ॥","translit_en":"amit jot jag jot prakarana(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou hast unlimited light, Thou art the illuminator of light in the world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਮਿਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਾਲੇ, ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ,"}}},{"verse_id":80542,"page_no":130,"line_no":80542,"gurmukhi":"ਖੜਗ ਪਾਣ ਖਲ ਦਲ ਬਲ ਹਰਣੰ ॥","translit_en":"khaRag paan khal dhal bal harana(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art the bearer of sword in Thy hand and remover of the strength of the forces of foolish tyrants."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੱਥ ਵਿਚ ਖੜਗ ਧਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ, ਦੁਸ਼ਟਾ ਦਾ ਬਲ ਹਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ,"}}},{"verse_id":80543,"page_no":130,"line_no":80543,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਾਬਾਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਭਰਣੰ ॥੯॥੨੯॥","translit_en":"mahaabaahu bisavai(n)bhar bharana(n) ||9||29||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art the Most Powerful and Sustainer of the Universe.9.29."},"pu":{"ss":"ਵੱਡੀਆਂ ਬਾਹਵਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਨੂੰ ਭਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ ॥੯॥੨੯॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":7747,"next":7749}}
files.shabads/15/7749.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":7749,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":54,"page_no":130,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":80544,"last_verse_id":80548,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":80544,"page_no":130,"line_no":80544,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥","translit_en":"tirabha(n)gee chha(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"TRIBHANGI STANZA"},"pu":{"ss":"ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ:"}}},{"verse_id":80545,"page_no":130,"line_no":80545,"gurmukhi":"ਖਲ ਦਲ ਬਲ ਹਰਣੰ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਰਣੰ ਅਸਰਣ ਸਰਣੰ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥","translit_en":"khal dhal bal harana(n) dhusaT bidharana(n) asaran sarana(n) amit gata(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thou art the remover of the strength of the forces of foolish tyrants and causest fear fear amongst them Thou art the Keeper of patroness under Thy refuge and hast Unlimited movement."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!
